summary: First backend test pass for Bachein. 34/34 pytest cases passed (100%) covering health, categories, auth (signup/login/me with valid+invalid+duplicate cases), AI generation & legal review via Gemini through Emergent LLM key, and the full secure document lifecycle: create (secure+normal), list sent/received, open tracking, 3rd-party 403, OTP gate, send-otp, verify-otp (wrong+correct), voice-oath gate, voice-oath submit, read-progress persistence, signature, status tracker, vault for both sender and receiver, and 404 on unknown document. All tests run against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://nda-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api). No backend issues found.

minor.issue: When mode='normal' but recipient_email is provided, security_config is forced to None yet status='sent' — recipient receives an unguarded document. Behaviour is intentional per current spec but worth documenting; consider warning the sender in UI.
Wrong OTP test uses '000000' which has a 1-in-1M collision chance with the real OTP. Test gracefully skips if collision occurs. Not a backend bug.

action_items: None for backend. Frontend integration testing recommended next.
Optional hardening (not blocking): consider rate-limiting /api/auth/login and /api/documents/{id}/send-otp; consider invalidating prior OTP on resend (already does — verified).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 549 lines — close to the 700-line threshold but still manageable; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, ai, documents) before adding more endpoints.
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env is a placeholder ('bachein-secret-key-change-in-production-2026') — fine for preview, must be rotated for production.
OTP returned in API response (otp_demo) is documented as demo-only — ensure removal before production or gated behind an env flag.
Pydantic .dict() is deprecated in Pydantic v2 (line 352). Prefer .model_dump(). Not failing tests but emits deprecation warnings.
FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') (line 547) is deprecated; recommend migrating to lifespan context manager.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude _id via projection. UUID used as primary key — good.
Sender cannot trigger send-otp (correctly returns 403) — verified.
Sign endpoint correctly enforces OTP and voice gates when security_config flags are true — verified.
seed_data_creation: Created/ensured users alice@bachein.com and bob@bachein.com via signup-or-login helper (idempotent). One ephemeral stranger user created per run for 403 test. Documents created: 1 secure NDA (signed end-to-end) and 1 normal draft. All test docs prefixed with 'TEST_'.
